pages.title: Item Enchanting
pages.content:
blacksmith's touch - 1 enchant applied
rune crafter - 2 enchants applied
master smith - 3 enchants applied

pages.title: Starlight Imbuing
pages.content:
starlight imbuing - aka stardust imbuing is a mechanic that buffs an item's damage and increases every apply but there's a catch— every apply increases the cost by 10 stardust
which isn't good if you have basically no stardust
luckily— daily quests and weekly quests award stardust
so it shouldn't be too hard to max it out
which is level 10 btw

![Imbue Panel](data:image/webp;base64,)

pages.title: Progression Progress
pages.content:
progression progress is the amount of % you have for badges
there are 70 badges in the game excluding my own amethyst badges which is 63
you gain progression by unlocking badges
completing all normal badges unlocks the first progression star
completing all badges gives the secret progression star
completing all amethyst badges gives the amethyst star

pages.title: Rift Arena
pages.content:
rift arena - also known as "rift survival" in-game is the default quest game for weeklies and event missions
it has a set time where you have to survive and the more longer it goes the mobs start gaining speed

pages.title: Quest Player
pages.content:
the quest player — aka the *player* is the one you control with wasd or the arrow keys during minigame quests
it has 2 forms
1. orb
2. square

pages.title: Admin Panel
pages.content:
the admin panel is exclusive to the owner (me!) and on the local server for testing
it cannot be obtained normally without using a local server
it has a set amount of features for testing
or just messing around

stormlander v2.title: Stormlander V2
stormlander v2.content:
not to be confused with [[Stormlander]]

## Stormlander V2
the stormlander v2 is an electric weapon dealing 299 damage and when it hits a mob in the arena it strikes it as well as chains the lightning to the nearest mob
it's also the second version of the original with improved stats and a new image icon
